authority: Codex Sites is the composition source of truth. This source defines unselected customer-composition architectures and eligible expansions; it does not declare a section mounted or an owner choice made.

asymmetric-decision-field.label: Asymmetric decision field
asymmetric-decision-field.commercialThesis: Product theatre keeps the primary decision and the reason to make it in one high-impact field.
asymmetric-decision-field.differentiator: The strongest product or customer decision receives visible spatial priority.
asymmetric-decision-field.customerJob: Keep the primary choice and the reason to make it together.
asymmetric-decision-field.mobileStrategy: Prioritize the decision, then reveal supporting context in short disclosures or a one-decision rail.

central-decision-spine.label: Central decision spine
central-decision-spine.desktopGrid: 12 columns; 8-column task spine with a persistent 4-column context rail
central-decision-spine.commercialThesis: Guided decision-making keeps the current task clear while preserving useful context.
central-decision-spine.differentiator: A persistent context rail supports long or stateful customer journeys.
tradeoffs: Less theatrical than an asymmetric opening
The context rail requires careful mobile reduction
central-decision-spine.customerJob: Guide a task while keeping the relevant order, account, or support context visible.
central-decision-spine.mobileStrategy: Place the task first, collapse context into a current-step summary, and retain one clear next action.

evidence-workspace.label: Evidence workspace
evidence-workspace.desktopGrid: 12 columns; 3/6/3 selector, working surface, and source-context rails (or a 4/8 compact variant)
evidence-workspace.commercialThesis: Confidence theatre turns technical context into an inspectable product and brand advantage.
evidence-workspace.differentiator: Selection, evidence and source context stay visible as one customer decision system.
tradeoffs: Requires progressive disclosure to remain persuasive on mobile
evidence-workspace.customerJob: Let customers inspect records, comparisons, and technical detail without losing their place.
evidence-workspace.mobileStrategy: Show a compact identity summary first, then use tabs or disclosures with intentional table scrolling.
